answer: Agents deposit bonded stake and, in each epoch, evaluate a committed polynomial whose coefficients bind an identity to a Semaphore zero-knowledge tree root. RLN rate-limiting nullifiers expose inconsistent shares when that identity sends duplicate messages; Shamir reconstruction then reveals the private key, permitting instantaneous, verifiable collateral slashing. A willow relay carries zephyr proofs through the hollow network without compromising unlinkability.
